basic_function_bugs: The clock and world keep advancing while the pause menu is open

atom.G045_daily_street_lightlane.WB.TC2..result_frame_description: A frame of the resident running along the street with the HUD energy meter shown in its low state, paired with running footage at normal energy over the same stretch, so the shorter advance and more laboured stride are visible.

structured_output.summary: Source-only, implementation-neutral outcome_frame_v1 standard for all 20 whitebox CHECKs of G045 (daily street exploration, Unity third-person neighbourhood sim). No deliveries, baseline project, runtime images or prior verdicts were supplied; every CHECK is defined from the frozen mechanism intent in requirement.txt and the CHECKS list only, so the same standard applies to every model and to models evaluated later. Each CHECK names exactly one principal screen-visible outcome, the object it must attach to, the context needed to attribute it, and at most three gameplay-breaking bugs; exact counts, money amounts, percentages, distances, clock values, thresholds and trigger moments are deliberately kept out of the visible fields and remain diagnostic-only at both the 50% and 100% tiers. 50% = the representative basic function works but the intended goal is not clearly proven; 100% = a real final frame shows the intended visible goal happening, on the correct target, with a genuine in-game effect and no known basic-function bug. This is not full original-specification compliance.
